in_marathi.name: Kabiraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wise, Old, Master
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kabiraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kabiraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'kabir' meaning 'wise' and 'raj' meaning 'master' or 'king'. This name is used to denote a wise and knowledgeable leader. In Hindu mythology, Kabir is considered a saint and a devotee of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. He is known for his wisdom and spiritual teachings.
